steps.action: Setup in the browser as Administrator: profile menu, Settings, Documents, Matters tab, Add type "DOC-030 documents-2 Matter type 09251138"
steps.expected: The new type is listed on the Matters tab; Matter imports can then show Type
steps.actual: Settings → Documents opened /settings/documents/matters (active Matter types before: DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Board resolution renamed 0925112134, DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Board resolution renamed 0925112257). Add type, New type name, Save listed "DOC-030 documents-2 Matter type 09251138" (read-back active).

steps.action: Create and maintain folders steps 1-2: Documents tab, New folder, Name, Save; an empty folder has no expand control
steps.expected: The folder row appears without an expand control
steps.actual: New folder opened a dialog with Name and Save. The "DOC-030 Admin Parent" row appeared reading "DOC-030 Admin Parent Empty" with no expand control.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders steps 2-3: New subfolder and Rename from Actions for the … folder; a folder with contents gets an expand control
steps.expected: The subfolder is created inside; the parent gains an expand/collapse control; Rename changes the name
steps.actual: Actions for the DOC-030 Admin Parent folder offered New subfolder; its dialog "New folder in DOC-030 Admin Parent" created the child, shown under the parent, which now had an expand/collapse control. Rename opened "Rename folder" and changed "DOC-030 Admin Child draft" to "DOC-030 Admin Child". Read-back: the child's parent is DOC-030 Admin Parent.

steps.action: Folder name rules: a case-only duplicate sibling, a blank name, a slash, '.' and '..' are refused
steps.expected: Each attempt shows a refusal in the dialog and creates nothing
steps.actual: All five names were refused in the dialog and no folder was created (2 folders before and after). "DOC-030 ADMIN PARENT": A folder named DOC-030 ADMIN PARENT is already here.; "   ": Give the folder a name.; "DOC-030 a/b": A folder name cannot contain a slash. Make a folder inside instead.; ".": A folder cannot be named . or .. — those address a path, not a folder.; "..": A folder cannot be named . or .. — those address a path, not a folder..

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 3: Move, Move into, None; a folder cannot move into itself or a descendant
steps.expected: Move into omits the folder and its descendant, the server refuses a cycle, and None returns a folder to the top level
steps.actual: Move into for "DOC-030 Admin Parent" offered None, DOC-030 Admin Other: not the folder itself or its child. A second-actor request to move it into its own child was refused (409: A folder cannot be moved inside itself.) and into itself (409). Moving "DOC-030 Admin Child" into "DOC-030 Admin Other" read back as DOC-030 Admin Other/DOC-030 Admin Child; Move into None put it at the top level.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: Actions, Move to folder, File in, Move; None moves it out
steps.expected: The Document is filed in the folder and then moved back to the record
steps.actual: Move to folder opened "Move doc030-admin-loose-a.txt" with File in; choosing "DOC-030 Admin Parent" filed the Document there, shown after expanding the folder. File in None moved it back onto the record (read-back).

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: drag a Document row onto a folder row, then onto Drop here to move out of folders
steps.expected: Dragging files the Document into the folder and back out
steps.actual: Dragging the "doc030-admin-loose-b.txt" row onto the "DOC-030 Admin Other" folder row filed it there (read-back). Dragging it from inside the folder showed "Drop here to move out of folders"; dropping on it moved the Document back to the record.

steps.action: Create and maintain folders step 4: select checkboxes and Move in the selection bar
steps.expected: Both selected Documents move into the chosen folder
steps.actual: Selecting both checkboxes showed "2 selected" with Move. The "Move 2 documents" dialog with File in "DOC-030 Admin Parent" filed both Documents there (read-back).

steps.action: Folder Delete dissolves the folder: contents move to its parent or the record; nothing is deleted
steps.expected: The confirmation says where contents go; the Documents stay live on the record
steps.actual: The confirmation read "Delete the DOC-030 Admin Parent folder? Anything in it moves onto the contract itself. Nothing is deleted. Cancel Delete". After Delete the folder was gone and both Documents were live at the record root (read-back).

steps.action: Import several files step 3: Type starts on No type, or on the type chosen in the upload dialog; a Contract import always shows Type
steps.expected: The Import dialog's Type starts on No type after a plain pick and on the chosen type after one was picked in Upload document
steps.actual: Upload, Choose files with two files opened "Import 2 files" with Type on "No type"; its options were No type, Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Executed, Amendment, DOC-030 access Admin document type 09251012. Choosing Type "Executed" in Upload document first, then two files, opened the Import dialog with Type already on "Executed". Cancel closed both without uploading.

steps.action: Import several files steps 1-5 and Recover a partial import: Destination Record root, Type, a real oversize file and a dropped connection; counts, row Retry, Done
steps.expected: Good files stay as v1 Documents of the chosen type; the oversize row is named without Retry; the dropped row has Retry and a retry sends only it; Done closes
steps.actual: Choose files with three text files and a 101 MiB file opened "Import 4 files" reading "Import 4 files Destination Record root doc029-bulk-a.txt 46 byte doc029-bulk-b.txt 46 byte doc029-bulk-c.txt 46 byte doc030-oversize.bin 105.9 MB Type No type Draft · ours Draft · theirs Redline · theirs Redline · ours Executed Amendment DO". The Type control's help (aria-describedby batch-type-help) read "Applied to every file in this import. Notes are not collected in bulk.". With Type "Draft · theirs" and the browser dropping the connection once for doc029-bulk-c.txt, the dialog settled as "Imported 2 of 4 files 2 of 4 files uploaded doc029-bulk-c.txt That file could not be uploaded. Retry doc030-oversize.bin That file is over the 100 MB upload limit. doc029-bulk-a.txt Done doc029-bulk-b.txt Done 2 files failed. The other 2 are on the contract. Retry uploads the selected file again. Files over the size limit must be reduced before retrying. 2 files are already on the contract. Retry 1 file Done 2 of 4 u". The oversize row had no Retry (count 0); the dropped row had "Retry doc029-bulk-c.txt"; the footer offered ["Retry 1 file"]. The two good files were already on the record (+2). Row Retry sent only the dropped file: "Imported 3 of 4 files 3 of 4 files uploaded doc030-oversize.bin That file is over the 100 MB upload limit. doc029-bulk-a.txt Done doc029-bulk-b.txt Done doc029-". Done closed it. The record gained exactly 3 Documents, each at Version 1 with Type Draft · theirs (read-back).

steps.action: Import step 5: when every file uploads the dialog closes after the list refreshes
steps.expected: The dialog closes by itself and both files are listed
steps.actual: A two-file import with no failure closed the dialog by itself; the Documents list showed the new rows and the record gained two Documents (read-back).

steps.action: Recover a partial import: Cancel remaining stops queued work; uploaded files remain; final counts are shown
steps.expected: Queued files are cancelled, finished uploads stay on the record, and the dialog shows the final counts
steps.actual: With each upload slowed four seconds by the browser, the running dialog said "Keep this dialog open until the import finishes." Cancel remaining settled it at "Imported 3 of 5 files": 2 file(s) read "Cancelled before it was uploaded." and the 3 uploaded file(s) were on the record (read-back +3).

steps.action: Keep a local folder structure: Choose folder keeps nested paths; the folder picker drops empty folders; a matching path is reused
steps.expected: The top-level folder and its nested child are created with their files; the empty folder is not; a second import reuses the path
steps.actual: Choose folder on a local tree (two files, one nested folder, one empty folder) opened "Import 2 files" reading "Import 2 files Destination Record root Folder structure is kept doc030-tree-admin-09251138 1 folder · 2 files sub-a 1 file doc030-nested.txt 23 byte doc030-top.txt 20 byte Type No type Draft · ours Draft · theirs Redline". The import created doc030-tree-admin-09251138 and doc030-tree-admin-09251138/sub-a with the files; the empty folder was not created. Importing the same tree again reused doc030-tree-admin-09251138 (still one folder of that name).

steps.action: Import steps 1-2 and Keep structure: drop a local folder on a folder row; Destination is that folder; a dropped tree recreates empty folders
steps.expected: The Import dialog names the folder as Destination and the empty folder is recreated
steps.actual: Dropping the local tree on the "DOC-030 Admin Other" row opened a dialog reading "Import 2 files Destination DOC-030 Admin Other Folder structure is kept doc030-tree-admin-09251138 2 folders · 2 files empty-dir Empty sub-a 1 file doc030-nested.txt 23 byte doc030-top.txt 20 byte Type No type Draft · ou". The import created DOC-030 Admin Other/doc030-tree-admin-09251138/sub-a and the empty DOC-030 Admin Other/doc030-tree-admin-09251138/empty-dir.

steps.action: Import step 3: a Matter import shows Type when the Matter list has a type; the chosen type is applied
steps.expected: Import 2 files on a Matter shows Type with No type and "DOC-030 documents-2 Matter type 09251138"; both new Versions carry it
steps.actual: The Matter's active type list held 3 type(s). Import 2 files showed Destination and Type (start "No type"; options No type, DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Board resolution renamed 0925112134, DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Board resolution renamed 0925112257, DOC-030 documents-2 Matter type 09251138). With "DOC-030 documents-2 Matter type 09251138" chosen, both new Documents were Version 1 of that type (read-back).

steps.action: Import step 3: an Entity import shows Type only when the Entity list has a type
steps.expected: The Type control is present exactly when the Entity type list is not empty
steps.actual: The Entity type list held 0 active type(s) (none). On Entity "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin folders Entity 09251138 Ltd", Import 2 files showed Destination and no Type control. Cancel closed it.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 1: Documents from navigation; Recent shows up to five Documents by current-Version upload, not by opening
steps.expected: Recent lists at most five in newest-current-Version order, and opening an older Document does not change it
steps.actual: The Documents navigation link opened the repository. Recent listed 5 Documents in the same order as the newest-current-Version read (repo-autodoc-admin-09251138.docx, repo-knowledge-admin-09251138.pdf, …). After opening the older "repo-folder-admin-09251138.docx" and returning, Recent still matched the upload-time order and did not add it.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 2: Filter, Owner, Contracts/Matters/Entities/Auto-Docs/Knowledge, Apply
steps.expected: Owner offers the five kinds and each narrows to paper of that owner kind
steps.actual: Owner offered Contracts, Matters, Entities, Auto-Docs, Knowledge. Contracts: 50 rows including repo-root-admin-09251138.pdf; Matters: 50 rows including repo-matter-admin-09251138.pdf; Entities: 50 rows including repo-entity-admin-09251138.pdf; Knowledge: 50 rows including repo-knowledge-admin-09251138.pdf; Auto-Docs: 3 rows including repo-autodoc-admin-09251138.docx. Each list left out the fixture paper of the other owner kinds.

steps.action: Search and narrow step 3: Record with Search choices; Folder becomes available for one Contract, with Record root; no Folder for Knowledge or Auto-Docs
steps.expected: Record narrows to one Contract; Folder picks the folder or Record root

steps.action: Search and narrow steps 4-5: Format and Kind take several values; different filters must all match; Kind describes the current Version; Counterparty, Uploader; Uploaded From/To includes both dates; remove one filter; Clear all; Recent hidden while filtered
steps.expected: Any-of within a filter, all-of across filters, current-Version kind, inclusive dates, and Recent only without filters

steps.action: Open the matching paper: selecting the name opens the owning record with the current Version; expand the chain for an earlier round
steps.expected: The record opens with the reader on v2 and the chain lists v1
steps.actual: The repository row read "repo-root-admin-09251138.pdf C-447 · DOC-030 documents-2 Admin repository Contract 09251138 Draft · theirs PDF 33.3 kB 2 DO Daniel Okafor this minute" (owning reference C-447). Selecting "repo-root-admin-09251138.pdf" opened C-447's Documents tab with the reader on "repo-root-admin-09251138.pdf, version 2". Expanding the chain and selecting the earlier round opened version 1.

steps.action: Missing or archived: a hidden record's Document does not appear through a filter, the list, or a direct link
steps.expected: An Administrator reaches every Contract, so the Confidential Contract's paper is listed
steps.actual: As Administrator, Record choices for C-446 offered "DOC-030 documents-2 hidden owner 09251138", the repository read listed its Document, and the record's Documents read answered 200. The guide does not claim an Administrator is refused.

steps.action: Missing or archived: Filter, Show archived includes archived Documents; the offered Restore brings one back
steps.expected: The archived row appears marked Archived with Restore; Restore makes it live
steps.actual: After archiving "repo-archive-admin-09251138.txt" it was absent from the Record-filtered list. Filter, Show archived added its row "repo-archive-admin-09251138.txt Archived C-447 · DOC-030 documents-2 Admin repository Contract 09251138 — TXT 46 byte 1 DO Daniel Okafor thi" with a Restore action; Restore made it live again (read-back).

steps.action: Missing or archived: an empty result after filters; Clear all widens again
steps.expected: The empty answer is shown and Clear all returns the whole list
steps.actual: Record C-447 with Format Email gave "No documents match these filters. Clear filters to return to the whole list.". Clear all brought back the whole list (50 rows on the first page) and Recent documents.

steps.action: Before you start: drag a live Contract Document row onto a Move to folder target inside its owning record
steps.expected: The Move to folder panel names the record's folders and the drop files the Document
steps.actual: Dragging the "repo-drag-admin-09251138.txt" row revealed the Move to folder panel with "DOC-030 Admin Repo folder" as a target; dropping on "DOC-030 Admin Repo folder" filed the Document there (read-back).

steps.action: Before you start: open Knowledge from the navigation
steps.expected: Knowledge opens with New, All Knowledge and the Knowledge items list
steps.actual: The navigation link Knowledge opened /knowledge with New, the All Knowledge folder entry and the Knowledge items region as Daniel Okafor.

steps.action: Organize the library step 2: Add folder, Folder name, Add folder at top level; then a child under the selected folder
steps.expected: With All Knowledge selected the folder is top-level; with a folder selected the new folder is its child
steps.actual: Add folder with All Knowledge selected saved "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 parent" with no parent. With that folder selected, Add folder saved "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 child" under it (read-back).

steps.action: Start with files steps 1-2: New, New from files; Folder starts at the selected folder, or at Library
steps.expected: Folder reads Library with All Knowledge selected and the selected folder otherwise
steps.actual: With All Knowledge selected, New from files showed Folder "Library". With "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 parent" selected it started at "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 parent".

steps.action: Start with files steps 2-3: Drop files here or choose files, two files, a Type, Create drafts
steps.expected: Each file creates a separate draft item named after the file with its own primary Document; the first item opens and the other is in Knowledge
steps.actual: Create drafts opened "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 policy A.pdf" with the Draft marker, Audience Legal Only, Type Precedent, the parent folder and its file under Primary document. The Knowledge breadcrumb returned to the list, and the parent folder listed both items. Each was a draft with one Document of its own as primary (read-back).

steps.action: Start with files step 4: Title saves on Enter and on leaving the field; Type and Folder save on change
steps.expected: Each value is saved and survives a reload
steps.actual: Enter saved "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 policy A renamed". Moving focus to Type saved "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 policy A reviewed". Type Playbook and Folder "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 child" saved on change. After a reload Title, Type and Folder showed the saved values.

steps.action: Start with guidance steps 1-2: New, New Knowledge Item, Title, Type, Folder, Attach documents with no type choice for the files; Create item; a failed upload offers Retry failed uploads
steps.expected: No Document type control; the item exists after the failed upload; Retry failed uploads uploads the file; the item is Draft and Legal Only; the file shows the item's Knowledge type
steps.actual: New Knowledge Item took Title, Type Article, Folder and one file through Attach documents. The dialog offered no Document type or Document kind control (counts 0/0); it read "New Knowledge Item Title* Type* Template Precedent Playbook Article Checklist Note DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Knowledge probe type 09251115 DOC-030 admin-config V-C38 Knowledge probe type 09251116 DOC". The browser dropped the first upload request: the dialog read "Record created. Some documents could not be uploaded." with Retry failed uploads and Continue, and the item already existed with no Document. Retry failed uploads uploaded the file and opened the item: Draft marker, Audience Legal Only, "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 playbook.docx" under Primary document. Its Document row's "Type of version 1" control showed "Article" (options No type, Article), the item's Knowledge type; read-back type Article.

steps.action: Start with guidance step 2: Continue after a failed upload keeps the item
steps.expected: Continue opens the created item without the failed file
steps.actual: With the upload request dropped, Continue closed the dialog and opened "DOC-030 documents-2 Admin 09251138 continue": a Draft item with no Document (read-back).

steps.action: Start with guidance steps 3-4: Add guidance, Markdown, Preview saves on blur and renders, Edit returns to the source; raw HTML is not rendered

steps.actual: Add guidance opened the editor; its help read "Guidance Preview Guidance Use Preview to see how your guidance will appear to readers." and named no Markdown rules. Preview saved the source on blur and rendered the heading, bold and italic text, a two-item list, inline code and the link. The raw <b> tag did not become a bold element. Edit showed the source again; the source was still there after a reload.

steps.action: Add Documents step 1: upload a new Document in the item's Documents section

steps.action: Organize the library step 5: Delete selected folder, read the confirmation, Delete folder; items and child folders move to its parent
